label: Hero
description: Driven to protect others and uphold the village ideal.
coreMotivation: Protect the innocent and preserve peace.
moralApproach: Acts for the greater good, even at personal cost.
typicalGoals: Safeguard the village, help others, become a role model.
narrativeConflicts: Burden of expectation, sacrificing self for duty.

label: Villain
description: Pursues personal ideals through destruction and fear.
coreMotivation: Reshape the world by force, regardless of cost.
moralApproach: Ends justify the means; harm is acceptable.
typicalGoals: Gain power, destroy enemies, rewrite the world order.
relationshipToAuthority: Opposes village authority and shinobi system.
narrativeConflicts: Hunted by villages, isolation, cycle of vengeance.

label: Anti-Hero
coreMotivation: Achieve a noble outcome by any means available.
moralApproach: Morally ambiguous; willing to get hands dirty.
typicalGoals: Protect loved ones, eliminate threats, survive.
relationshipToAuthority: Distrusts authority; works outside it when needed.
narrativeConflicts: Inner conflict between methods and ideals.

label: Anti-Villain
description: Pursues a noble goal through villainous actions.
coreMotivation: Save someone or something at any cost.
moralApproach: Believes their cause justifies the harm caused.
typicalGoals: Protect a person, revive a lost one, save a clan.
relationshipToAuthority: Conflicted; may serve or oppose depending on goal.
narrativeConflicts: Tragic gap between intention and action.

label: Neutral
description: Follows personal balance, not moral extremes.
moralApproach: Pragmatic; avoids taking sides unless necessary.

label: Chaotic
description: Acts on whim, unpredictable and unbound.
coreMotivation: Freedom from all rules and expectations.
typicalGoals: Create change, escape constraints, follow curiosity.
narrativeConflicts: Unreliable to allies and enemies alike.
